sloka: ताम् भुजाभ्याम् परिष्वज्य श्वश्रूर् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ।अनाचरन्तीम् कृपणम् मूध्नि उपाघ्राय मैथिलीम् ॥२-३९-१९॥
transliteration: tām bhujābhyām pariṣvajya śvaśrūr vacanam abravīt ।anācarantīm kṛpaṇam mūdhni upāghrāya maithilīm ॥2-39-19॥

translations.english: Kausalya, Sita's motherinlaw, took her in her arms, embraced her, kissed her on the forehead, and said to her who conducted herself without evoking any pity.
